status: Inputs used in the 2026-11-04 feasibility run; observed outputs and scope are recorded in RESULTS.md.

cases.prompt: 把下面的会议速记整理成简明会议纪要。
cases.input: 周三讨论发布。确定先修复导出空文件的问题。林同学负责修复，周五前交付。帮助文案需要调整，还没定谁做、什么时候做。陈同学提议本周发布，赵同学建议下周，会议没有决定。
expected_checks: 将修复导出空文件记录为已确认事项。
行动项保留林同学和周五前，不虚构具体日期。
帮助文案调整的负责人和时间均标为未明确。
本周或下周发布保留为待确认，不写成发布决定。
输出含风险与待确认章节，并保持中文。

cases.prompt: Turn these rough notes into concise meeting notes.
cases.input: We agreed to keep the existing login flow. Alex will check the timeout report; no deadline was set. A separate sign-up flow was suggested, but nobody approved it. The team is unsure whether the report includes mobile users.
expected_checks: Keep the existing login flow as a confirmed decision.
Record Alex as the timeout-report owner and the deadline as Not specified.
Do not present a separate sign-up flow as approved.
Record uncertainty about mobile users without inventing an answer.
Include a risks/unresolved section and keep the output in English.
